spec_case: issue #403: a member-access chain past Circuitry's own recursion budget for this shape
description: A 2000-link member-access chain fails cof itself before the document ever runs: path collection walks the whole parse tree once per '.' link with no recursion guard, raising a RecursionError. core/cel_eval.py::_compile now catches it and raises the same one line every other CEL check error uses, framed with the failing effect's own path (issue #629) -- electricity matches the phase (rejected at compile time, the document never runs) and now this exact text too, well past its own MAX_ACCESSOR_NESTING_DEPTH.
